note: Borough election, 20 May 1964: one alderman and two councillors for each of the five wards. Both tables are taken from the returning officer's notice of result (R. Lyttle, returning officer, Sir Thomas Dixon Buildings, Victoria Road; Larne Times, 28 May 1964, p. 3). Two polls: the Gardenmore aldermanship and the Central Ward councillors (also reported in the Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1964, p. 7); every other alderman and councillor was returned without a poll. No party labels are printed in the notice. Returned unopposed.
